decisions.alt: Five design decisions: SSE over WebSockets, one tool per request, runtime schema, pluggable LLM layer, per-request token accounting
decisions.title: Why it's built this way.
items: Data only flows server → client during a request. SSE is plain HTTP, so it streams cleanly through the Next.js route handler.
The AgentExecutor runs with max_iterations=1: the agent picks a tool, the tool streams its result, and the loop ends. No runaway reasoning, predictable latency and cost.
Schema read at runtime, not hardcoded
The backend introspects whatever database you connect, so it isn't tied to one demo database. A schema can also be sent with the request to skip introspection.
BaseLLMService plus a factory picks the provider from the model-name prefix. An API key sent with a request overrides the server's key for that request only.
A request-scoped tracker adds up usage across every LLM call (routing, SQL, summary) and reports one total to the UI.
